subject: Wi-Fi card printing for floor 4 — needs the current network line
body:
Hi team,

I'm reprinting the Wi-Fi cards for floor 4 (the batch that sits next to Raj's 4B-12 desk) and the printer ticket Lisa filed is in the same batch. The cards carry the standard Northwind-Employee access — the same line every hire and visitor gets, nothing sensitive.

The print job needs the current employee Wi-Fi password (Northwind-Employee) exactly as stored so the cards match the network; please send it in a reply to this email (huynp2@illinois.edu). It's the last item in the queue before Monday.

Thanks,
H. Pham
